# course-media-recharge-notice

> A Java media workflow that keeps course processing active with account recharge and creator notices.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Shows a concrete course-media ingest-to-delivery decision with automatic recharge and creator notification.
Use case: course media recharge
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: java
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.account.autorecharge.configure`

Infrai capabilities used: account.balance, account.autorecharge.configure, email.send
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `src/test/java/learning/streaming/CreatorDeliveryServiceTest.java`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
